'''Garragor''' was a member of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] who lived in [[3963 BBY]]. He was a member of the [[Jedi Covenant]], a secret [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] organization trying to prevent the returning of the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]], and was completely loyal to its founder, [[Krynda Draay]].

[[File:GarragorAndKlydeker-KotOR32.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Haazen giving an order to Garragor and Klydeker]]
When [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Xamar]] brought fugitive [[Padawan/Legends|padawan]] [[Zayne Carrick]] inside [[Draay Estate]], he, along with many other [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]], was present at the confrontation between Zayne and his former master, [[Lucien Draay]]. It was at this time that Krynda's aide [[Haazen]] asked Garragor and his fellow Jedi [[Klydeker]] to fetch diagnostic equipment from the big red case present nearby. Little did they know that the case also contained [[Sith artifact/Legends|Sith artifacts]], until Haazen usurped the position of the leader of the Covenant and revealed himself as the servant of the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]].

He was later seen lying next to Klydeker in a courtyard, struck down by Haazen after attempting to stop his madness.
